steps.description: Define beautiful background drawables, colors, styles, and custom visual buttons for Material Theme.

steps.description: Implement complete layout with username, password input, authentication buttons, and redirect link.

steps.description: Design OTP requesting and password resetting fields on dynamic layouts.
